title: Putting a gym online may leave the old owner key working for good, and nobody is told
what: When a gym that already had the member app turned on is put online, the panel asks the server once to switch off the old owner key, so that from then on the only way in is a person on the Staff & sign-in list. If that one request fails (a network blip, a timeout), the failure is thrown away without a word or a log line, the panel moves on to Staff & sign-in as if all went well, and it never tries again. The old key then keeps full owner access to the gym, outside the staff list, and cannot be signed out from it.
expected: Switching off the old key is retried until the server confirms it, or the owner is told it did not happen and offered a way to finish it; the failure is at least logged.
how_often: rarely: only when that one request fails while going online
fix_line: Retry switching off the old key until it succeeds, log the failure, and tell the owner if it still has not happened

items.reason: filtered by script, 92 rows, not read (other silent.csv rows of panel/auth-data); read: 14 silent catch rows and 55 fallback rows
